home.heroText: Laptop matches come from the local product catalog. For desktop PCs, Gemini offers general buying guidance; product details and compatibility are not verified here.
home.heroNote: Local laptop catalog · Gemini desktop guidance · Verify current prices
home.howText: Three simple steps from “I don't know where to start” to a build you understand.
home.step1Text: Share your budget in rupees, what you'll use the computer for, and what matters most to you.
home.step2Text: Review matching laptop models or get general desktop hardware guidance from Gemini. Verify specifications, prices, availability and compatibility with manufacturers and retailers before buying.
home.step3Text: Compare actual models or component records, and verify current product facts before buying.
home.featuresText: No spec-sheet knowledge needed. We handle the technical parts and explain them simply.
home.feature1Text: Laptop matches use your workload, budget and priorities. Gemini provides general desktop hardware guidance based on your needs.
home.feature2Text: Gemini does not verify desktop component compatibility. Check sockets, memory, power requirements and case fit against manufacturer specifications.
home.feature3Text: Results come from catalog records. Missing images, specifications, prices and compatibility data are labelled rather than guessed.
home.ctaText: Answer a few quick questions to see matching laptop models or get general desktop hardware guidance from Gemini.

why.title: Buying a PC should feel clear, not stressful.
why.lead: TechPickr is built for people who are not sure where to start. We turn your budget and goals into options you can understand.
why.tapTopic: Tap a topic to see how it works.
why.personalText: Your budget, your use case and your priorities decide the result. A student who edits video and a student who studies get different builds, because their needs are different.
why.personalPoint1: Budget in rupees, up to your limit
why.personalPoint2: Use case: gaming, editing, programming and more
why.personalPoint3: Up to three priorities that change the scoring
why.honestTitle: We say when we don't know
why.honestText: TechPickr identifies AI-generated advice and clearly states when product facts, prices and compatibility have not been verified.
why.honestPoint1: No live prices or verified benchmarks are presented
why.honestPoint2: Clear labels when information is unverified
why.honestPoint3: Compatibility is not presented as verified
why.plainTitle: Every part comes with a reason
why.plainText: You don't need to read spec sheets. Each suggestion includes a simple reason and points out facts to verify before you decide.
why.plainPoint1: A “Why this part?” note for each choice
why.compareText: Review general hardware approaches for your needs, then verify current products and prices before choosing.
why.comparePoint3: Pick the trade-off that suits you
why.with3: A plain-language reason for each part
why.with4: Results based on your budget and goals
why.faq1a: Yes. It is a school hackathon project and has no paid plans.
why.faq2a: Recommendations are AI-generated guidance, not live retailer information. Verify product specifications, current prices and availability directly with manufacturers or retailers.
why.faq3q: Do I need to know about PC parts?
why.faq3a: No. The questions are about what you do and what you can spend. We handle the technical side and explain it simply.
why.faq4a: Yes. You choose a custom desktop or a laptop on the first question.
why.finalText: Answer a few quick questions and get general hardware guidance.

pcBuilder.title: Build a PC that fits your needs
pcBuilder.description: A few quick questions will help us find component suggestions that fit your budget. You can review and change your answers before we search.
pcBuilder.purposeTitle: What will you use your PC for?
pcBuilder.purposeHelp: Choose all that apply. Select at least one.
pcBuilder.budgetHelp: Set the most you want to spend on components. You can adjust this before searching.
pcBuilder.budgetInputLabel: Maximum PC budget in Indian rupees
pcBuilder.budgetInvalid: Enter a whole amount in rupees, using increments of ₹1,000.
pcBuilder.performanceHelp: Choose the level that sounds closest. Not sure? Balanced is a good place to start.
pcBuilder.basicText: Everyday tasks, browsing, and office apps.
pcBuilder.balancedText: A capable all-rounder for work, study, and play.
pcBuilder.highText: More demanding games, creative work, and heavy software.
pcBuilder.prioritiesHelp: Choose up to three. You can skip this step.
pcBuilder.reviewHelp: Make sure everything looks right. You can edit any answer before continuing.
pcBuilder.resultsDescription: These parts were returned by the component database. Review the available specifications and compatibility notes before buying.
pcBuilder.noComponentsTitle: No components found for this budget
pcBuilder.noComponentsText: The database did not return any parts for this budget. Try increasing your budget or changing your answers.
pcBuilder.overBudgetMessage: The listed component total is above your budget. Review the suggestions before purchasing.
pcBuilder.estimatedOverBudgetMessage: The estimated component total is above your budget. Retailer prices may differ, so compare the listings before buying.
pcBuilder.missingPrices: A complete set of component prices is unavailable, so the build total cannot be estimated. Use the retailer searches to check current listings.
pcBuilder.recommendationLimit: Only your budget currently affects the database recommendation. Your use cases, performance level, and priorities are collected for context but are not yet used as filters.
pcBuilder.selectionLogic: The database chooses the lowest-priced available part in each supported category within its category budget share. It does not verify that every selected part works together.
pcBuilder.priceNote: Component prices and totals are rounded estimates, not live retailer quotes. Check current seller prices and stock before buying.
pcBuilder.beforeYouBuyText: Compatibility is not fully verified. Check CPU and motherboard socket compatibility, RAM generation, case dimensions, power requirements, cooling clearance, and current seller prices yourself.
pcBuilder.requestFailed: We couldn't load PC component suggestions.

footer.description: Beginner-friendly PC and laptop matches from catalog records. Prices, stock and compatibility are not live-verified.
